tone.target: big open Foo Fighters rock crunch with layered drive and stadium space
tone.profile: big open Foo Fighters rock crunch with layered drive and stadium space
tone.summary: A powerful, anthemic Foo Fighters crunch achieved with a Tube Screamer boost into a UK 45/UK 50 style amp, complemented by Chorus for width and Room reverb for stadium space.
corrections: make it bigger and more anthemic
keep the drive thick, not metallic
allow subtle space, not heavy ambience

rig.name: Foo Fighters - Best Of You - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
Simulate a Tube Screamer style push to tighten the low end and boost mids for punchy power chords.
blocks.gap: Using 'Boost' as a general mid-hump/overdrive substitute for the classic TS sound, which is ideal for Foo Fighters rock crunch.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core mid-gain crunch and thickness required for anthemic rock power chords.
blocks.gap: The general 'Distortion' model provides enough grit without being overly metallic or fuzzy, fitting the Plexi/Marshall vibe.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the classic Marshall/Plexi voicing for big, open rock tones.
Provide the classic British rock cabinet sound.
Create a wide, layered guitar feel and anthemic space.
blocks.gap: Chorus is the best module for adding width without sounding overly psychedelic or distracting.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle stadium space and depth without heavy ambience.
Fine-tune the mid-range punch and clarity for thick power chords.
blocks.gap: Used to specifically address the 'less scooped' requirement by boosting mids.

blocks.purpose: Optional subtle echo for added dimension (kept off by default).
blocks.gap: The verdict specified avoiding 'extreme delay', so this is kept minimal and optional.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for more open, anthemic rock tone.

proposals.reason: Enhance the big, open stadium sound required for Foo Fighters.
